source.note: Character select is not in Interface.xdat. NCLobbyWnd / NCLobbyFunctionWnd / NCLobbyStartWnd are implemented in native C++ (nwindow.dll). Layout below was recovered from those OnCreate/OnPaint functions in the retail Interlude nwindow.dll (ImageBase 0x10000000). Screen placement of the three windows is computed at runtime from the current resolution; only local (window-relative) coordinates are hardcoded.

windows.name: NCLobbyFunctionWnd
windows.evidence: OnPaint draws the texture at local (0,0) with size 120x138 (push 0x78, 0x8A).

controls.name: btnCreate
controls.evidence: OnCreate: SetRect(13,20,96,23) then SetSysString(0x9E=158).

controls.name: btnDelete
controls.evidence: OnCreate: SetRect(13,45,96,23) then SetSysString(0x9F=159).

controls.name: btnReLogin
controls.evidence: OnCreate: SetRect(13,95,96,23) then SetSysString(0x374=884).

windows.name: NCLobbyStartWnd
windows.evidence: OnPaint draws the texture at local (0,0) with size 140x49 (push 0x8C, 0x31).

controls.name: btnStart
controls.evidence: OnCreate: SetRect(13,10,116,31) then SetSysString(0xA0=160).

windows.name: NCLobbyWnd_CharInfo
windows.note: The character-info card (Name / HP / MP / Exp, and numeric HP/MP/Exp text). There is no SP bar texture in this paint path; SP is a sysstring (92) and may be drawn as text only. Window size itself is the size of select1_back (not a literal in OnCreate). Related texture L2UI_CH3.LobbyWnd.select2_back is present in the same DLL and is used for the unselected/alternate card state.

controls.name: select1_back
controls.evidence: Ctor loads the texture; OnPaint draws it at the window origin, stretched to the window size.

controls.name: NameField
controls.evidence: Ctor SetRect(13,46,138,17) on the first created text/control (id 0x1F04).

controls.name: labelA
controls.evidence: OnPaint DrawText color 0xFFA3A3A3 at (15,16). Likely a field label.

controls.name: labelB
controls.evidence: OnPaint DrawText color 0xFFA3A3A3 at (15,39). Likely a field label.

controls.name: HPBar
controls.evidence: OnPaint draws esi+0x1CC (ps_hpbar) at (35,55), dest height 12, fill width = hp*85/maxHp capped at 85.

controls.name: MPBar
controls.evidence: OnPaint draws esi+0x1D0 (ps_mpbar) at (35,69), dest height 12, fill width capped at 85.

controls.name: EXPBar
controls.evidence: OnPaint draws esi+0x1D4 (ps_expbar) at (35,83), dest height 12, fill width capped at 206 (0xCE).

controls.name: valueTextColor
controls.note: Numeric HP/MP/Exp (and related) values are drawn in #FFDCDCDC. Several values are horizontally centered around x=77 or placed at x=67/83/131; y positions used include 57, 69, 71, 85. Re-read OnPaint if a pixel-perfect value label is needed.
